scenes.title: Hail on a standing crop
lines: is paid only if the farmer
scenes.say: Hail flattens a standing crop. Under the crop insurance scheme PMFBY, this loss is paid only if the farmer reports it within 72 hours. Fasal Nuksan Sahayak tells them how, in English and Hindi.

scenes.title: What happened?
scenes.say: One question per screen, with big buttons. First: what happened to the crop.

scenes.title: When, and where was the crop
scenes.say: When it happened, in India time, and where the crop was: standing, cut and drying in the field, or already taken home.

scenes.title: The answer, with its paragraph
lines: Deadline as date and hour IST
scenes.say: The answer: report this loss yourself, before this date and hour, with a live countdown, and the paragraph of the guidelines it relies on.

scenes.title: Where to report, fastest first
lines: A ready report to read out,
scenes.say: Then the fastest channels, starting with the toll-free 14447, what to have ready, and a report to read out on the call. Blanks stay blank: nothing is invented.

scenes.title: One tap: Hindi
scenes.say: One tap, and everything is in Hindi.

scenes.title: Rules tested, mutants killed
lines: IST on any phone time zone
scenes.say: The rules are tested at the edges: the 72 hour deadline, the 14 days after harvest, and India time on any phone. Each test was seen failing first.

scenes.title: Fasal Nuksan Sahayak
lines: Free, open source, no login, no ads
scenes.say: Fasal Nuksan Sahayak: free, open source, and light enough for a cheap phone on 3G.
